content: I open this thread to keep track of the open PRs related to Quotient Manifolds. This project was previously discussed in #ItaLean 2025 > Projects: Quotient Manifolds, but I thought it'd have more visibility here.
The main PR is this: #40727, which proves the quotient by a smooth action of a manifold is itself a manifold.

But this currently depends on this smaller PR:

#43717

Which adds a lemma isLocalHomeomorph_quotientMk_of_properlyDiscontinuousSMul.

This lemma makes things more tidy in the main PR. However, in order to add it without repeating many variables I had to modify the order of some results in Mathlib/Topology/Covering/Quotient.lean.

I'm not sure this is the best way to do it, so feedback on that choice would be very welcome.

The main PR, defining the IsManifold instance for quotients by smooth actions is now ready for review: #40727

I have left a couple of questions in the PR description. I'd appreciate any feedback!
